cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.title: EXPLORATORY VESSEL "PHLOX"
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.3: Day forty. Still no Atmos. Still going to find out.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.4: Long-range scan: vacuum. It has been vacuum for forty days.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.5: Sensors are top of the line. Passed QA. Mostly. Eventually.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.6: Atmos moves with no trajectory. Plotting it is superstition.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.7: You don't find Atmos. My grandmother swore it finds you.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.8: Islands held in the sky like beads. The Church calls it Eden.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.9: Empty islands. Nobody on them. I came for the quiet.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.10: The quiet can wait. Supper's ready, and everyone eats together.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.12: I don't eat. Save me a bowl anyway.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.15: Reactor's spiking! Venting deck 2, grab something!
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.16: Everyone to the core ring. Now. Move!
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.18: Deck 3 is open to space! Is anyone still down there?
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.19: Deck 3 was empty. I checked. Keep moving.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.20: Nav array's failing. Rerouting... no. It's gone.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.22: We were always flying blind out here. Cut our speed.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.23: Too much mass to brake! Dump the cargo pods!
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.25: Earth Spirit, if you are listening, now would be very good.
cutscene.skylore_islands.arrival.31: Brace! We're going to hit the isl—
